whatsappMessage:
Hi Team MW Bistro,

I noticed your bus cafe has fantastic 4.8★ reviews with 300+ happy customers on Mall Rd in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, interactive menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mwbistro

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team MW Bistro, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and mobile-first menu display for your location on Mall Rd in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
